name: tatami
description: Tatami Room inside Claude Code: room mail above the prompt, desk status, a name tag, a /room pane with the plan, glows for your turn and for what needs your OK, and edits kept off teammates' files and the user's checkout

wake.title: Wake for tasks and messages
wake.description: When this window's agent is idle and a teammate hands it a task, sends it a message, or finishes work for it to land, start a turn so it acts (uses your plan; at most 3 wake-ups in 30 minutes)

chime.title: Chime when Claude needs your OK
chime.description: Play a soft two-note chime on Windows when this window starts waiting for a permission answer

glow.title: Glow for your turn and for what needs your OK
glow.description: When Claude finishes, a box above the prompt breathes in sky blue; when it asks before running a tool, that tool's row pulses in red until you answer
